evaluation.rationale: The notes suffer from severe structural bloat, repeating the same information across duplicate sections (e.g., 'Action items' and 'Action items (structured)'). This repetition destroys conciseness and readability. Furthermore, the notes present superseded, tentative decisions (migrating to Kafka, writing a Kafka spike plan) as final decisions and action items, directly contradicting the actual final decisions recorded later in the same document. The notes also hallucinate that the broker decision remains unresolved pending Grace's input, even though Grace explicitly made the decision during the meeting. While most facts are retained, the contradictions and hallucinations make the notes highly unreliable.
